label: Record each draft
description: Domain graph behind customer.registerAll where the customers live behind an upstream API: the same fan-out as record-all, and nothing that says the rows move together. An HTTP call cannot take part in a transaction, so this profile gets the graph without the promise rather than a promise the upstream cannot keep. Which of the two a run uses is the binding's choice, and the caller's graph does not change.
